title: Allahabad HC Orders UP Police to Pay Rs 25,000 for 12 Extra Days in Jail
case_name: Leelawati Devi v. State of U.P. and Others
card_summary: The Allahabad High Court directed the Uttar Pradesh police department to pay Rs 25,000 to a woman who was kept in jail for twelve extra days in a dowry death case. The extra detention followed the police department's failure to give the state counsel timely instructions on her bail application. The court directed that the amount be paid within a month.
card_tip: Where a department's delay in instructing counsel on a bail plea causes extra days in custody, that delay can itself support a compensation claim against the state.
verification_notes: Decision date, compensation amount, twelve extra days in custody, and the link to delayed instructions on the bail plea are reported consistently by LiveLaw and The420 (which spells the petitioner's name 'Lilawati Devi'). Full judgment text not independently read; citation taken from LiveLaw.
